1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: if (!canvas) {
6:   throw new Error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
7: }
8: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9: const WIDTH = canvas.width;
10: const HEIGHT = canvas.height;
11: 
12: // Player configuration
13: const player = {
14:   x: 50,
15:   size: 20,
16:   // ground position (bottom of canvas minus player size)
17:   groundY: HEIGHT - 20,
18:   y: HEIGHT - 20,
19:   vy: 0,
20:   gravity: 0.6,
21:   jumpStrength: -12,
22:   isJumping: false,
23: };
24: 
25: // Obstacle configuration
26: const obstacles = [];
27: const obstacleSpeed = 4;
28: let obstacleTimer = 0;
29: const obstacleInterval = 1500; // ms
30: 
31: let score = 0;
32: let lastTimestamp = 0;
33: let gameOver = false;
34: 
35: function spawnObstacle() {
36:   const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30; // random width/height
37:   obstacles.push({
38:     x: WIDTH,
39:     y: HEIGHT - size,
40:     width: size,
41:     height: size,
42:   });
43: }
44: 
45: function resetGame() {
46:   player.y = player.groundY;
47:   player.vy = 0;
48:   player.isJumping = false;
49:   obstacles.length = 0;
50:   obstacleTimer = 0;
51:   score = 0;
52:   gameOver = false;
53:   lastTimestamp = performance.now();
54:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
55: }
56: 
57: function handleJump() {
58:   if (!player.isJumping) {
59:     player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
60:     player.isJumping = true;
61:   }
62: }
63: 
64: // Input: spacebar or mouse click/tap
65: window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
66:   if (e.code === 'Space') handleJump();
67: });
68: canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', handleJump);
69: canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
70:   e.preventDefault();
71:   handleJump();
72: });
73: 
74: function update(delta) {
75:   // Player physics
76:   player.vy += player.gravity;
77:   player.y += player.vy;
78:   if (player.y >= player.groundY) {
79:     player.y = player.groundY;
80:     player.vy = 0;
81:     player.isJumping = false;
82:   }
83: 
84:   // Obstacles movement
85:   for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
86:     const obs = obstacles[i];
87:     obs.x -= obstacleSpeed;
88:     // Remove off‑screen obstacles
89:     if (obs.x + obs.width < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
90:   }
91: 
92:   // Spawn new obstacles
93:   obstacleTimer += delta;
94:   if (obstacleTimer > obstacleInterval) {
95:     spawnObstacle();
96:     obstacleTimer = 0;
97:   }
98: 
99:   // Collision detection (AABB)
100:   for (const obs of obstacles) {
101:     if (
102:       player.x < obs.x + obs.width &&
103:       player.x + player.size > obs.x &&
104:       player.y < obs.y + obs.height &&
105:       player.y + player.size > obs.y
106:     ) {
107:       gameOver = true;
108:       break;
109:     }
110:   }
111: 
112:   // Score increases with time
113:   score += delta / 1000;
114: }
115: 
116: function draw() {
117:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
118: 
119:   // Draw player (black square)
120:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
121:   ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
122: 
123:   // Draw obstacles (gray rectangles)
124:   ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
125:   for (const obs of obstacles) {
126:     ctx.fillRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.width, obs.height);
127:   }
128: 
129:   // Draw score
130:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
131:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
132:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
133: 
134:   if (gameOver) {
135:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
136:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
137:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
138:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
139:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
140:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 10);
141:     ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + Math.floor(score), WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
142:     ctx.textAlign = 'start';
143:   }
144: }
145: 
146: function loop(timestamp) {
147:   const delta = timestamp - lastTimestamp;
148:   lastTimestamp = timestamp;
149:   if (!gameOver) {
150:     update(delta);
151:     draw();
152:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153:   } else {
154:     draw(); // draw final frame with overlay
155:   }
156: }
157: 
158: // Start the game
159: resetGame();
